S.FORM: alang Tjailjaking ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Santimon go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 240 buwan, 875 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 94% kyan ku 820 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 6% kyan ku 55 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 84%, Rukay 2%, Bunun 1%, Puyuma 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 5%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Tjailjaking hya' ga Sagaran. tay mkyahu' na Tjailjaking hya' ga Timur. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tjailjakiŋ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu [s|ɕ]antimon ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** rukaj * βunun * pujuma * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na tjailjakiŋ ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]aɣaran taj mkjaħuʔ na tjailjakiŋ ħjaʔ ɣa timur reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
